title: Querying in Entity Framework Core
description: Learn LINQ queries, eager loading with Include/ThenInclude, and projection queries.

data.text: Querying in EF Core supports LINQ-to-Entities with optimized SQL generation and the ability to include C#/VB.NET functions in queries.
EF Core allows including C# functions in LINQ queries (not possible in EF 6):

data.title: C# Function in Query
data.content: Using C# method in LINQ Where clause

data.text: Use `Include()` to load related entities in a single query:

data.title: Include Example
data.content: Loading related Grade entity with Student

data.text: Use `ThenInclude()` to load multiple levels of related entities:

data.title: ThenInclude Example
data.code:
var student = context.Students
    .Where(s => s.FirstName == "Bill")
    .Include(s => s.Grade)
        .ThenInclude(g => g.Teachers)
    .FirstOrDefault();

data.text: Use multiple `Include()` calls for multiple navigation properties:

data.title: Multiple Include
data.code:
var studentWithGrade = context.Students
    .Where(s => s.FirstName == "Bill")
    .Include(s => s.Grade)
    .Include(s => s.StudentCourses)
    .FirstOrDefault();

data.text: Use projection to load related entities without Include:

data.title: Projection Query
Key Takeaways
points: C# functions can be used in LINQ queries
Include() for eager loading related entities
Projection queries as alternative to Include
data.takeaway: Continue to learn about raw SQL queries.
